claim: deploy.yml (Deploy to Production) acts only on this repository's own pushes to main. ci-gate carries no job-level if and has a step, "The run is this repository's own push to main" (if exactly github.event_name == 'workflow_run', no continue-on-error), that reads the triggering run's event and head repository through env and exits 1 unless they are 'push' and this repository. Every other job declares a job-level if; each workflow_run-startable job names workflow_run only inside the own-push group, read with comments stripped; rollback-guide cannot be started by a workflow_run; no step sets continue-on-error. So a fork pull request whose branch is named main (matched by `workflow_run: branches: [main]`) never has its head_sha checked out beside ADMIN_API_KEY. Held by scripts/check_deploy_own_pushes.py (gate-owned), whose --self-test plants 10 breaks including the five the round-2 ADR 0090 planner found surviving the first version of this check; run by scripts/test_pr_audit_gate.py. Not held: behaviour on GitHub itself (workflow_run runs main's copy of the file, so the new step first runs on the merge commit's Deploy run).
